name: zyz-worker-watchdog
description: execute-task watchdog: reports silent/dead subagent roles and stale task status files so the main agent intervenes. Armed with when=always because on-skill-invoke matches the EMITTED skill name exactly, and a plugin-loaded skill emits the qualified form (zyz-worker:execute-task) while the same skill used in project mode emits the bare form (execute-task) — one literal cannot cover both. watchdog.sh is itself gated on the .zyz-worker/current-task pointer, so arming it always is equivalent in effect and costs one sleeping process.
